matchup_findings.statement: Wake Forest holds the early-down edge: its offense stays ahead of the chains on 1st and 2nd down against this defense (+1.69) more than NC State does (-0.84).

Wake Forest owns the stronger opponent-adjusted explosive-play matchup: NC State offense vs Wake Forest defense -1.45, Wake Forest offense vs NC State defense +1.87 (explosive-play rate, opponent-adjusted: Wake Forest offense #23 of 138, NC State defense #121 of 138).

Wake Forest owns the stronger opponent-adjusted sustained-efficiency matchup: NC State offense vs Wake Forest defense -0.58, Wake Forest offense vs NC State defense +1.54 (success rate, opponent-adjusted: Wake Forest offense #26 of 138, NC State defense #97 of 138).
Wake Forest's rushing offense meets a NC State defense it out-rates on the matchup scale (+1.67) (rush success rate, opponent-adjusted: Wake Forest offense #21 of 138, NC State defense #113 of 138).
Wake Forest's explosive rushing offense meets a NC State defense that allows explosive rush plays (+1.79).
NC State's offense has swung widely from game to game relative to its opponents (game-to-game residual variation in the 88th percentile of FBS).

pace.definition: possession_environment = (z of home offense plays + z of away defense plays allowed + z of away offense plays + z of home defense plays allowed) / 2, on adjusted values. Positive = more snaps than an average FBS game. tempo_environment = -(z of each offense's possession seconds per play) / 2

volatility.definition: offense_ypp_residual_sd = game-to-game spread of the offense's yards per play around what the fit expected against each opponent; its percentile is within the FBS universe. explosive_yard_share_z is the raw share standardised across FBS (not opponent-adjusted). takeaways_per_game_z and giveaways_per_game_z are RAW per-game turnover counts standardised across FBS: turnovers are regression-prone and are deliberately not opponent-adjusted.

adjusted_unavailable_reason: descriptive tendency: opponent adjustment does not apply to this metric (V1)
